architecture: v8 independent highlight-context branch initialized from parent predictor; frozen parent source/restorer/shadows. Only highlight branch trained; ordinary and shadow outputs must stay bit-exact. Inference remains single-frame, no optical flow/recurrent state.
sampling: Uniform scene then exposure-group then adjacent pair0/1 or1/2, full320x512 frames. No validation optimization or checkpoint selection.
acceptance: New scene-disjoint development: H error >=5% better than parent and no worse than analytic; exact outside-highlight preservation; zero new negativeY; constrained partial display <=1code. Same parent comparison on old coherent24; legacy scores retained unchanged. Full real motion/detail/grade checks required before adoption, not inferred from static scores.
scope: Controlled feasibility trial with original planar-motion pairs of CC0 sources; no claim of real-motion or fresh release coverage. This expands trainable spatial context and adds explicit temporal supervision after isolated-head ablations failed.
